subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should authenticated hook-agent callers be allowed to opt into persistent session reuse for scoped stable session keys while isolated mode remains the default?
rationale: Current runtime and documentation define hook-agent turns as isolated; persistent reuse is a new operator-controlled capability that permits external hook traffic to re-enter stored conversation state.

options.title: Allow explicit persistence
options.body: Land an opt-in persistent mode gated by hook authentication and allowed session-key prefixes, with isolation unchanged by default.

options.title: Keep isolation only
options.body: Reject persistent hook reuse and retain the current isolated hook-agent contract and documentation.

recommendation.title: Allow explicit persistence
recommendation.body: Land an opt-in persistent mode gated by hook authentication and allowed session-key prefixes, with isolation unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the isolation behavior and has already provided the clearest current product and security direction for this issue.
